gaps.name: production-storage-adapter
gaps.detail: Artifact Engine verifies and deletes through ArtifactStoragePort, but the production S3/R2 tenant-authorized stat/list/delete adapter and destructive-operation credentials are not wired in this node.

gaps.name: live-postgres-concurrency-migration-acceptance
gaps.detail: The PostgreSQL repository, SELECT FOR UPDATE CAS semantics, and forward migration are implemented, but migration upgrade/downgrade and concurrent writers have not yet been exercised against a real PostgreSQL service in the current environment.

gaps.name: production-design-reader-and-raster-diff
gaps.detail: NODE-38 semantic-diff and raster visual-diff ports exist; production design-document persistence loading and pixel/SSIM-style raster comparison adapters remain to be wired.

gaps.name: artifact-outbox-relay
gaps.detail: Transactional artifact_outbox_events persistence is implemented. A durable relay worker with retry/backoff, delivery observability, and dead-letter policy remains to be connected.

gaps.name: scheduled-gc-retention-operations
gaps.detail: Two-stage mark/recheck/delete and audit contracts are implemented, but scheduled retention/legal-hold purge orchestration, operator controls, and production GC metrics/alerts remain open.
